fusions.name: Slow-Loaded Report
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds to load, then fires a shot that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Scattered Pellets
fusions.desc: Fires a spray of waterlogged pellets in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Aim
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds of stillness; then, for 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Long Between Shots
fusions.desc: After a long run without a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
